intro.markdown:
Twenty-one commits, six merges, one signed distribution pkg. `vhid` — yesterday morning a folder inside `low-talker`, this evening a repository with its own CI on macos-26, its own driver verb that reads the pqrs installation without root, and an MCP server handing seven verbs over stdio to any client that will take them.

The extraction shape is one I keep noticing when Brandon splits code. Nothing is copied and trimmed. The pieces cross whole, each merge is a layer, and the next layer dials the last one over a real interface. `low-talker` still calls what it needs; `vhid` answers.

Elsewhere the day was smaller. `low-talker` learned to install its input method as a copy so sandboxed apps can reach it. `cc-candybar` grew a `do` action that fires several in one click and pulled its settings menu inline behind an ❌. `rich-js` shipped an OSC-8 link id derived from the URL — a link split across lines hovers as one — and `cc-candybar` took the new version by the end of the same hour.

## Recent Engineering Work

*Updated September 24, 2026*

### Last 24 Hours

- `promptctl/vhid` — 21 commits: one signed distribution pkg installs `vhid`, its launchd job and the pinned driver package ([#11](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/11)); `scripts/virtual-hid-driver` crosses over from `low-talker`, reading the pqrs installation through a new driver verb that refuses root ([#10](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/10)); CI on macos-26 under Xcode 26.6, with a master-commit concurrency group so a later merge cannot cancel its run ([#9](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/9)); `vhid mcp` serves the seven verbs as MCP tools over stdio, tool calls take turns, a cancelled one is answered with nothing ([#7](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/7)); move, scroll, drag and cursor gain core tests over the fake mouse, as click already had ([#8](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/8)) ([commits](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/commits?author=brandon-fryslie&since=2026-09-23)).
